verdict.rationale: Windmill's AI Agent flow steps make consuming external MCP servers a fair question, but nothing in the evidence documents it. The MCP evidence [windmill-docs-17, windmill-probe-4] covers the opposite role: Windmill acting as an MCP server for clients like Claude or Cursor. The AI Agent steps [windmill-docs-20] mention only connecting to AI providers and models, not plugging in MCP servers as tool sources.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
